notes: Pa25470dabf G4. Printed: 'Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.' The G1 trace cannot show a control change (the probe snapshot reads the zone owner), so this pack does. Seat 0 casts it on the opponent's tapped 3/3 Ogre: seat 0 controls the Ogre (CR 613 layer 2), it is untapped, and having haste it can attack the turn it changed control (CR 302.6). It attacks seat 1, its owner, for 3 (20 -> 17) and is tapped by the attack.
